notes: Dating: on-air cues fix this run to Feb-Apr 1985 and show the weekly estimates are 3 weeks too late for 163-170 and 174: 164 = Tue 19 Feb 1985 ('tomorrow night is Rosh Chodesh Adar'), 166 = 5 Mar ('tomorrow, Wednesday, is Taanis Esther'), 169 = 26 Mar (Erev Pesach 'next Friday, 5 April'), 170 = 2 Apr (Rambam's birthday 'this Friday', Chol HaMoed 'this Monday'). 163/165/167/174 were placed by sequence. Worth re-anchoring the interpolation for nearby episodes (about 112-210).

Episode 168 is missing from the batch and from the catalog (row null); 171-173 are also absent. 174 fits 30 Apr 1985 (mid-Sefirah, no Lag BaOmer mention), which suggests there was no gap in the weekly sequence over Pesach.

1658b83955 (166): hint candidate 5120830d37 (episode 218) checked: its opening Purim Merrymakers skit and Purim songs are nearly word for word the same. Added aired_again_in (text_overlap, 0.85). 218 is probably the following year's Purim show reusing these segments.

Serial pairs linked with continues/part_of_set: Three Lost on an Island (164->165), The Mystery of Toras Emes (166->167), The Rambam's Resting Place (169->170). 163 and 174 are complete single stories.
